title: Commit-scan result (F153-FR-026; data-model.md D11 — the one typed unit)
description: What one scan of one candidate tree with one rule set pinned at launch answers: the hits that decide, whether the tree is blocked, the files scanned and the per-file counts. A hit names the rule and never the match text (F152-FR-010, F153-FR-027). The one result the pre-critic step, the commit-time step and the in-pass command consume, so no second implementation can disagree with the gate it advises on (F153-FR-026). PROPOSAL of spec 153 — not normative until its tasks land.

file.$comment: the file of the commit, as the caller named it

line.$comment: the line, 1-indexed; 0 where the file could not be read (the gate fails closed)

pattern.$comment: the NAME of the value pattern that matched — never the matched text

registeredSecret.$comment: true where the hit is a registered secret

unreadable.$comment: true where the file could not be read at all

blocked.$comment: true where at least one deciding hit stands: the commit gate holds the commit back

files.$comment: the files that were hit, in the order the caller gave them

counts.$comment: the count of hits of each file of `files`, aligned with it
